title: Dataset of intracranial EEG, scalp EEG and beamforming sources from epilepsy patients performing a verbal working memory task

affiliations.name: Klinik für Neurochirurgie, UniversitätsSpital Zürich, Universität Zürich
Klinik für Neurochirurgie, UniversitätsSpital Zürich, Universität Zürich

description: This dataset comprises simultaneous intracranial and scalp EEG recordings from 15 epilepsy patients performing a modified Sternberg verbal working memory task. The collection includes raw iEEG from depth electrodes, 10-20 system scalp EEG, electrode anatomical localization with MNI coordinates, and LCMV beamforming-reconstructed virtual sensor data from key cognitive regions including temporal superior lobe, lateral prefrontal cortex, occipital cortex, posterior parietal cortex, and Broca's area. The dataset enables investigation of working memory mechanisms through multimodal electrophysiological recordings and source reconstruction.
methods_description: Subjects performed a modified Sternberg task with temporally separated encoding, maintenance, and recall phases. Simultaneous recordings included scalp EEG (10-20 system) and intracranial EEG via depth electrodes. LCMV beamforming was applied to reconstruct virtual sensor data from temporal superior lobe, lateral prefrontal cortex, occipital cortex, posterior parietal cortex, and Broca's area. Trial information (set size, match/mismatch, correctness, response time) was recorded for each trial.
